utfall: tiltak 1–5: ingen samlet effekttall; kapittelet oppsummerer at voksenopplæring kan gi bedre sysselsetting og inntekt, men at gevinsten ikke er automatisk
sitat: The LM benefits of AE are therefore not inevitable or automatic, and insights from research and evaluations are important for promoting better understandings of the conditions that may be necessary in order to secure the benefits of AE.

utfall: tiltak 3: opplæringskuponger i Chile ga små negative effekter på sysselsetting og inntekt, især for dem som ville bytte bransje (gjengitt fra Kaplan et al. 2015); ingen tall oppgitt
sitat: Overall, small negative impacts on employment probabilities and earnings were found especially among adults who wanted to switch the sector in which they were employed.
